## About
Houston Automatic Transmission Service is a family owned and operated shop in northwest Houston. Our focus is the part of your vehicle that gets power to the wheels: transmissions, transfer cases, clutches, differentials, axles and everything else on the drive line.
Our mechanics keep up with their training, and no job is too big or too small. We work on cars, trucks, SUVs and vans, we look after fleet vehicles, and we handle RV maintenance and repair too.
We're rated 4.6 from 77 Google reviews, and we'd be glad to have you stop by.

## Services
- Transmission repair and rebuilds: Automatic and manual transmissions, foreign and domestic, repaired or fully rebuilt.
- Clutches and differentials: Clutch and differential repair, along with transfer case work.
- Fleet service: Maintenance and repairs for company vehicles. We sit down with you first and set up a maintenance program that fits your schedule.
- RV service: Regular maintenance to keep your RV running longer and help it hold its value.

## FAQ
Q: Do your repairs come with a warranty?
A: Yes. All major repairs come with our standard 2 year/24,000 mile warranty.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: We're at 18902 Highway 249, Houston, TX 77070, 1 mile north of FM 1960 W, between Grant and Cypresswood.

Q: Do you serve areas outside Houston?
A: Yes. We also work with folks from Spring, Cypress, Magnolia, The Woodlands, Tomball, Bear Creek, Copper Field and Jersey Village.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and closed on weekends.
